429.description:
**Too Many Requests**

The BNSF API Gateway enforces rate limits to maintain application security and performance.  Current rate limits are set as follows:
* 1 API Request Per Second, Per Partner, Per Service
* 15 API Requests Per Minute, Per Partner, Per Service
* 100 API Request Per Minute, Per Service
 
When requests exceed these limits the API Gateway will return **429 Too Many Requests** error response to the Client.  Upon receiving such exceptions, the client can resubmit failed requests in a rate-limited manner, complying with the API Gateway throttle limits.

400.description:
**Bad Request**

The request could not be understood by the server due to incorrect syntax. Do not repeat the request without modifications.

403.description:
Unauthorized request. Here are the most common causes:
    
* You are getting 403 Access Denied.

   * It takes a few days for us to get you set up after you register. When set up is complete, you will receive an email letting you know. If you have not received the email, please wait up to five business days. Let us know via API Support if you still have not received the email after five business days.
   * You can also get this error if your certificate is not configured properly on your side. Please review the Mutual Authentication in the Getting Started section of our documentation.


* You are getting 403 "message": "Insufficient privileges" when accessing a restricted service for which you do not have permission. You can use our Registration form to request access. Be sure to explain the situation in the "Please explain how you intend to use the API" field.

404.description:
**Not Found**

The server cannot find the requested resource (URI). That is, the address of the endpoint in your request does not exist. Please consult the documentation.

405.description:
**Method Not Allowed**

The request HTTP method is known by the server but has been disabled and cannot be used for that resource. For example, you may be using GET when POST is required. Please consult the documentation.

429.description:
**Too Many Requests**

The BNSF API Gateway enforces rate limits to maintain application security and performance.  Current rate limits are set as follows:
* 1 API Request Per Second, Per Partner, Per Service
* 15 API Requests Per Minute, Per Partner, Per Service
* 100 API Request Per Minute, Per Service
 
When requests exceed these limits the API Gateway will return **429 Too Many Requests** error response to the Client.  Upon receiving such exceptions, the client can resubmit failed requests in a rate-limited manner, complying with the API Gateway throttle limits.

500.description:
**Internal Server Error**

The server encountered an unexpected condition which prevented it from fulfilling the request. This is always a problem on the server side. Our internal support systems will be made aware.

504.description:
**Gateway Timeout**

The server is acting as a gateway and cannot get a response in time for a request. Wait about one minute then try again.

scac.title: SCAC
scac.description: SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) consists of a two to four character alpha abbreviation used to designate a transportation company. SCACs are assigned by NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association).

fsac.title: FSAC
fsac.description: FSAC (Freight Station Accounting Code) is a number assigned to a station that uniquely identifies the station within the context of each reporting railroad (i.e., Different railroads might share identical FSAC numbers).

splc.title: SPLC
splc.description: SPLC (Standard Point Location Code) is a six-to-nine digit geographic code used by North American transportation industries, which serves as the official code assigned to a city or point (for rate making purposes) within a city.

railincRegisteredStationIndicator.title: Railinc Registered Station Indicator
railincRegisteredStationIndicator.description: Indicates is the associated Station is registered with Railinc.

stationName.title: Station Name
stationName.description: Name of a station. This may or may not be the fully spelled name of the station but it is NOT the standard 333 abbreviated name.

station333.title: Station 333
station333.description: Name of a City, where a Station is located, which has been abbreviated from the City's Full Name through the use of a standardized programmatic algorithm.

stationStateCode.title: Station State Code
stationStateCode.description: Station State Code is a code value, as defined by the appropriate government agency of the United States, Canada, or Mexico, specifying the state or province of a station.

railincStation333.title: Railinc Station 333
railincStation333.description: 333 Abbreviated name for the city where a station is located as defined by Railinc and not by BNSF.  See also Station 333.

r260JunctionCode.title: R260 Junction Code
r260JunctionCode.description: R260 Junction Code is a code value (as specified by AAR Accounting Rule 260) which specifies a junction where two rail carriers interchange shipments.

stationSixCharacterAbbreviation.title: Station Six Character Abbreviation
stationSixCharacterAbbreviation.description: Six character abbreviation for a BNSF, MRL (Montana Rail Line), or LAJ (Los Angeles Junction Railway) Station.  Internal value assigned at BNSF.

stationThreeCharacterAbbreviation.title: Station Three Character Abbreviation
stationThreeCharacterAbbreviation.description: Three character abbreviation for a BNSF, MRL (Montana Rail Line), or LAJ (Los Angeles Junction Railway) Station.  Internal value assigned at BNSF.

stationTwoCharacterAbbreviation.title: Station Two Character Abbreviation
stationTwoCharacterAbbreviation.description: Two character abbreviation for a BNSF, MRL (Montana Rail Line), or LAJ (Los Angeles Junction Railway) Station.  Internal value assigned at BNSF.

stationTimeZoneCode.title: Station Time Zone Code
stationTimeZoneCode.description: Code that defines the time zone where a station is physically located.

crewTimeReportingTimeZoneCode.title: Crew Time Reporting Time Zone Code
crewTimeReportingTimeZoneCode.description: Code that defines the time zone where the crew reports time when working at a given station. This value may or may not be the same as the time zone of the station itself.

stationTssTimeZoneCode.title: Station TSS Time Zone Code
stationTssTimeZoneCode.description: Code that defines the time zone for a station as recorded within BNSF's TSS (Transportation Support System) application.

stationObservesDaylightSavingTimeIndicat.title: Station Observes Daylight Saving Time Indicator
stationObservesDaylightSavingTimeIndicat.description: Indicates whether or not the station observed Daylight Savings Time.

opslStationNumber.title: OPSL Station Number
opslStationNumber.description: The OPSL (Open and Prepay Station List) number assigned to a Railroad Station. Value is generated and maintained by the Business Services Division of Railinc.

opslStationSubNumber.title: OPSL Station Sub Number
opslStationSubNumber.description: Sub-number assigned to further define the Station as recorded within the OPSL (Open and Prepay Station List). This list is maintained at the Industry level for all Registered Stations.

opslStationName.title: OPSL Station Name
opslStationName.description: Name of the Station as recorded on the OPSL (Open and Prepay Station List) from which the Station information was recorded.

stationLatitude.title: Station Latitude
stationLatitude.description: The latitude, distance north or south of the equator as measured in degrees, where the Station is physically located.

stationLongitude.title: Station Longitude
stationLongitude.description: The latitude, distance east or west of the prime meridian as measured in degrees, where the Station is physically located.

systemBlockNumber.title: System Block Number
systemBlockNumber.description: System block identifying the general geographic area of the railroad assigned by the systems operations center. System block is defined as a group of stations.

stationCarhireReloadAbbreviation.title: Station Carhire Reload Abbreviation
stationCarhireReloadAbbreviation.description: Abbreviation referring to 'Carhire Reload Station' as defined by Railinc. This abbreviation is a 5 positions alpha value.

stationCustomsInspectionRequiredIndicato.title: Station Customs Inspection Required Indicator
stationCustomsInspectionRequiredIndicato.description: Indicates whether or not U.S. Customs is required to  perform an inspection of cars and intermodal equipment for customs clearance at the associated station.

grainInspectionRequiredIndicator.title: Grain Inspection Required Indicator
grainInspectionRequiredIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not a recognized grain inspection authority is required to perform an inspection of grain.

stationAutomotiveRampTypeCode.title: Station Automotive Ramp Type Code
stationAutomotiveRampTypeCode.description: Code that defines the type of Automotive Ramp located at the associated Station.

stationTssRampTypeCode.title: Station TSS Ramp Type Code
stationTssRampTypeCode.description: Code that defines the type of Ramp, as recorded within TSS (Transportation Support System), located at the associated Station.

stationMaximumGrossWeightPounds.title: Station Maximum Gross Weight Pounds
stationMaximumGrossWeightPounds.description: The maximum gross weight, measured in pounds, that can be handled on rail at this station location.

stationOperatingPlateCode.title: Station Operating Plate Code
stationOperatingPlateCode.description: The maximum Plate Size (car dimensions) that can be handled at this location.

stationLocomotiveFuelingTypeCode.title: Station Locomotive Fueling Type Code
stationLocomotiveFuelingTypeCode.description: Code that defines the types of fueling available at this station for a locomotive.

stationImportExportTypeCode.title: Station Import Export Type Code
stationImportExportTypeCode.description: Code that defines the type of imports and/or exports that are handled at the associated station.

stationTrainClassificationServiceLevelCo.title: Station Train Classification Service Level Code
stationTrainClassificationServiceLevelCo.description: Code indicating the station's class/service level for train service.

fipsCountyCode.title: FIPS County Code
fipsCountyCode.description: Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) code for the County of the location as determined by the Bureau of Economic Analysis of the U.S. Department of Commerce.

usbeaRegionCode.title: USBEA Region Code
usbeaRegionCode.description: Bureau of Economic Analysis assigned code defining geographic regional economic areas.

usbeaCountyName.title: USBEA County Name
usbeaCountyName.description: Bureau of Economic Analysis Name value which corresponds to the FIPS County code.

legacyStationId.title: Legacy Station ID
legacyStationId.description: Internal Station Randomly Generated Key field used in the Legacy Mainframe.  Not needed in the new Station Hub.

stationReportingScac.title: Station Reporting SCAC
stationReportingScac.description: The SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) of the carrier that reported/registered this Station at Railinc.

payrollTripTicketPrefixCode.title: Payroll Trip Ticket Prefix Code
payrollTripTicketPrefixCode.description: Code indicating the prefix for a payroll trip ticket. A payroll trip ticket is when the trip ticket has been approved for payment.

updateDatetime.title: Update DateTime
updateDatetime.description: The UTC* Date and Time** when a business process persists (saves) modification of business data.

componentEconomicAreaCode.title: Component Economic Area Code
componentEconomicAreaCode.description: Component Economic Area Code in which the county specified in the FIPS County Code belongs.

stationScacInternationalCarrierIndicator.title: Station SCAC International Carrier Indicator
stationScacInternationalCarrierIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not the Station's SCAC is an international carrier.

stationOnsiteScaleIndicator.title: Station Onsite Scale Indicator
stationOnsiteScaleIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not this station has a scale onsite.

stationOnsiteCleaningFacilitiesIndicator.title: Station Onsite Cleaning Facilities Indicator
stationOnsiteCleaningFacilitiesIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not this station has cleaning facilities onsite.

stationTrafficTypeCode.title: Station Traffic Type Code
stationTrafficTypeCode.description: Code that defines the type of traffic that can be handled at this Station.

stationMechanicalRegionCode.title: Station Mechanical Region Code
stationMechanicalRegionCode.description: The mechanical region, within the BNSF network, where the associated station is located. Note: These may differ than the Business/Marketing Regions.

stationMechanicalZoneName.title: Station Mechanical Region Code
stationMechanicalZoneName.description: The mechanical zone, with a mechanical region, where the associated station is located.

stationComment.title: Station Comment
stationComment.description: Any comment found related to a Station.
stationComment.example: Sending to Railinc as a new Add

stationEmbargoIndicator.title: Station Embargo Indicator
stationEmbargoIndicator.description: Indicates whether or not this station has any Embargos applied to it.

stcc.title: stcc
stcc.description: STCC (Standard Transportation Commodity Code) number identifying a Commodity.

commodityDescriptionAbbreviation.title: commodityDescriptionAbbreviation
commodityDescriptionAbbreviation.description: A short description of the commodity.

stcc.title: STCC
stcc.description: STCC (Standard Transportation Commodity Code) number identifying a Commodity.

commodityRegulatoryAuthorityCode.title: Commodity Regulatory Authority Code
commodityRegulatoryAuthorityCode.description: Code that defines the authority body(s) defining the regulatory  requirements for a commodity.

hazardousCommodityProperShippingNameSequ.title: Hazardous Commodity Proper Shipping Name Sequence Number
hazardousCommodityProperShippingNameSequ.description: The order to be applied to the Proper Shipping Name(s) for a hazardous commodity.

unnaNumber.title: UNNA Number
unnaNumber.description: A number assigned to identify or classify a hazardous commodity/material as assigned by the UN (United Nations) or NA (North American/US DOT), required in commerce and transportation.

hazardousCommodityClassificationCode.title: Hazardous Commodity Classification Code
hazardousCommodityClassificationCode.description: Code indicating the classification applied to a hazardous commodity. May include Canadian, United States, and international codes depending on the data storage file and the type of shipments.

hazardousCommoditySecondaryClassificatio.title: Hazardous Commodity Secondary Classification Code
hazardousCommoditySecondaryClassificatio.description: Code indicating the secondary classification applied to a hazardous commodity. May include Canadian, United States, and international codes depending on the data storage file and the type of shipments.

canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.title: Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification 1
canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.description: The first, primary, Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification associated with a given material being shipped.

canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.title: Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification 2
canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.description: The second, secondary, Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification associated with a given material being shipped.

canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.title: Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification 3
canadianHazardousCommoditySubsidiaryClas.description: The third possible Canadian Hazardous Commodity Subsidiary Classification associated with a given material being shipped.

commodityPackagingGroupCode1.title: Commodity Packaging Group Code 1
commodityPackagingGroupCode1.description: Code which designates the first of up to three, Canadian or International, Packaging Groups assigned to a commodity.

commodityPackagingGroupCode2.title: Commodity Packaging Group Code 2
commodityPackagingGroupCode2.description: Code which designates the second of up to three, Canadian or International, Packaging Groups assigned to a commodity.

commodityPackagingGroupCode3.title: Commodity Packaging Group Code 3
commodityPackagingGroupCode3.description: Code which designates the third of up to three, Canadian or International, Packaging Groups assigned to a commodity.

hazardousCommodityProperShippingName.title: Hazardous Commodity Proper Shipping Name
hazardousCommodityProperShippingName.description: The full Proper Shipping Name assigned to a Hazardous Commodities as required by US, Canadian, and International Regulations.
hazardousCommodityProperShippingName.example: WASTE ETHYLENE OXIDE AND CARBON DIOXIDE MIXTURES

hazardousCommodityProperShippingAugmenta.title: Hazardous Commodity Proper Shipping Augmentation Required Indicator
hazardousCommodityProperShippingAugmenta.description: Indicates if Hazardous Commodity Proper Shipping Name(s) should be augmented with a Technical Name.

hazardousSubstanceComponentDescription.title: Hazardous Substance Component Description
hazardousSubstanceComponentDescription.description: Description of an element, or compound, associated with a hazardous substance.

hazardousCommodityToxicityTypeCode.title: Hazardous Commodity Toxicity Type Code
hazardousCommodityToxicityTypeCode.description: Code that defines the specific toxicity related statement required to be attached to the shipping papers when transporting a hazardous commodity.

primaryHazardousPlacardCode.title: Primary Hazardous Placard Code
primaryHazardousPlacardCode.description: The primary code, as defined by the US DOT or Canada, to be assigned to the hazardous placard when transporting/shipping hazardous materials.

secondaryHazardousPlacardCode.title: Secondary Hazardous Placard Code
secondaryHazardousPlacardCode.description: The secondary code, as defined by the US DOT or Canada, to be assigned to the hazardous placard when transporting/shipping hazardous materials.

canadianSpecialCommodityStatementCode.title: Canadian Special Commodity Statement Code
canadianSpecialCommodityStatementCode.description: Code that defines, per Canadian Regulations, what statement related to a special commodity are required to be included on the shipping papers.

canadianEmergencyResponsePlanRequiredCod.title: Canadian Emergency Response Plan Required Code
canadianEmergencyResponsePlanRequiredCod.description: Code that defines what, if any, Emergency Response Assistance Plan (ERAP) reference number and telephone number are required to appear on the shipping paper.

hazardousCommodityUsdotInhalationHazardZ.title: Hazardous Commodity USDOT Inhalation Hazard Zone Code
hazardousCommodityUsdotInhalationHazardZ.description: Code, assigned by the US DOT, that specifies any hazardous zone information that is required to be part of the shipping papers when transporting hazardous commodities that are considered to be poisonous by inhalation.

combustibleHazardousCommodityIndicator.title: Combustible Hazardous Commodity Indicator
combustibleHazardousCommodityIndicator.description: Code that defines if the associated commodity is considered to be combustible (Class 3 Commodities include items that are made of natural fibers including paper products or products made of wood).

marinePollutantComponentDescription.title: Marine Pollutant Component Description
marinePollutantComponentDescription.description: Description of the component in a hazardous material shipment that makes it a marine pollutant.

equipmentInitial.title: Equipment Initial
equipmentInitial.description: Equipment Initial is the prefix or alphabetic part of an equipment units identifying number.

equipmentNumber.title: Equipment Number
equipmentNumber.description: Equipment Number is the sequencing or serial part of an equipment units identifying number.

equipmentGroupCode.title: Equipment Group Code
equipmentGroupCode.description: Code that defines the logical grouping of equipment into major car types.

equipmentDraftGearTypeCode.title: Equipment Draft Gear Type Code
equipmentDraftGearTypeCode.description:
A code that defines the type of equipment that connects the couplings to the rolling stock, known as the draft gear or draw gear.
Railinc Element ID B073. Umler Element EQMVCPDS

grossRailWeightPounds.title: Gross Rail Weight Pounds
grossRailWeightPounds.description: The maximum permissible weight on rail of the equipment and the load, reported in pounds.

shipmentLoadLimitPounds.title: Shipment Load Limit Pounds
shipmentLoadLimitPounds.description: The number of pounds a shipment is allowed to weigh, the load limit, in order to allow it to be safely moved over rail.

equipmentTareWeightPounds.title: Equipment Tare Weight Pounds
equipmentTareWeightPounds.description: Equipment Tare Weight is the weight of an empty rail shipping container or vehicle measured in pounds. Sometimes called the unladen weight.

equipmentExternalLengthInches.title: Equipment External Length Inches
equipmentExternalLengthInches.description: The external length, measured in inches, of a piece of equipment.

equipmentTruckSideBearingTypeCode.title: Equipment Truck Side Bearing Type Code
equipmentTruckSideBearingTypeCode.description:
Code that defines the type of constant contact bearing located on the equipment's truck side. These bearings are used to stabilize equipment on curves and in high-speed service. 
Railinc Element ID A146

equipmentSpeedRestrictionLoadEmptyStatus.title: Equipment Speed Restriction Load Empty Status Code
equipmentSpeedRestrictionLoadEmptyStatus.description: Code that defines that a speed restriction related to the loaded or empty status applies to a piece of BNSF equipment.

equipmentSpeedRestrictionCode.title: Equipment Speed Restriction Code
equipmentSpeedRestrictionCode.description: Code that defines a speed restriction, in MPH (miles per hour), that applies to rail or rail equipment.

specialConditionHandlingInstructionsCode.title: Special Condition Handling Instructions Code One
Special Condition Handling Instructions Code Two
specialConditionHandlingInstructionsCode.description: The second set of instructions, conditions, or handling requirements for a shipment that help ensure that trains are built properly, safe movement occurs, shipments are held (e.g., clearance, customs, etc.), and awareness can be brought to any special handling needs.

specialConditionHandlingInstructionsCode.title: Special Condition Handling Instructions Code Three
specialConditionHandlingInstructionsCode.description: The third set of instructions, conditions, or handling requirements for a shipment that help ensure that trains are built properly, safe movement occurs, shipments are held (e.g., clearance, customs, etc.), and awareness can be brought to any special handling needs.

specialConditionHandlingInstructionsCode.title: Special Condition Handling Instructions Code Four
specialConditionHandlingInstructionsCode.description: The fourth set of instructions, conditions, or handling requirements for a shipment that help ensure that trains are built properly, safe movement occurs, shipments are held (e.g., clearance, customs, etc.), and awareness can be brought to any special handling needs.

bnsfCarKindName.title: BNSF Car Kind Name
bnsfCarKindName.description: Name given to physical characteristics for equipment as defined by BNSF Railway itself. Value is used when car characteristics are required for business decision making.

bnsfPoolId.title: BNSF Pool ID
bnsfPoolId.description: A four-digit code used by BNSF for a pool of cars assigned to a specific loading location.

bnsfPoolAlphabeticCode.title: BNSF Pool Alphabetic Code
bnsfPoolAlphabeticCode.description: An alphabetic code assigned to categorize a Pool of cars as assigned by BNSF.

equipmentAxleCount.title: Equipment Axle Count
equipmentAxleCount.description: The total number of axles attached to a piece of equipment.

articulatedUnitAirBrakeControlValveCount.title: Articulated Unit Air Brake Control Valve Count
articulatedUnitAirBrakeControlValveCount.description:
The total number of operating air brake valves, excluding hand breaks, found on an articulated unit.
Railinc Element ID A182.

jobStatusDescription.title: jobStatusDescription
jobStatusDescription.description:
* 1: Job in queue
* 2: Job is running
* 3: The job has data available
* 4: The job is complete

equipmentLoadEmptyStatusCode.title: Equipment Status Code
equipmentLoadEmptyStatusCode.description: L or E, this code describes whether the equipment is loaded or empty.

eventCode.title: Event Code
eventCode.description: Event Code indicates the event/activity abbreviation.

eventDescription.title: Event Description
eventDescription.description: Description for an Event Code used to define an event or activity occurring on the rail network.

eventStatusCode.title: Event Location Name
eventStatusCode.description: Event Status Code used with event code representing equipment activity.
